hardFunction.terminalFreedom: East end is a functional finished termination, not a joining plane. Its forms/details may improve while staying within one-cell contact and original small surface-relief/height clearance budget. Do not require old trim, topology or exact extrema.

originalDescriptiveMeasurements.interpretation: Maintain functional full-cell contact/clearance and nominal height1.17, with no new overflow beyond the original small0.011 side/end relief allowance. Source extrema are descriptive; no fitting or preserving old defects merely to match numbers. At west cut X must remain exactly-.5, with no overlap.

registration.numericalReview: Audit actual values. Source capture code checks projection/root within0.05 native pixel; geometry profile float storage errors are about1e-7 world unit. Tolerances accommodate numerical storage only, never per-view fitting, manual offsets or visible defects.
registration.publication: One uniform complete-native-frame BOX reduction from4× to2×, exact canonical rock-family operation. No crop, per-view shift/warp, recolor or manual alpha/RGB repair.

approvedMiddleContinuity.boundaryLaw: Canonical relief fades with sin²(pi*(x+.5)), giving zero X tangent at both cuts. Match actual external west profile and the canonical middle E boundary albedo/material/side normals after one-cell placement. Boundary vertex density/mesh count are descriptive; interpolation may differ only if the same profile/tangent/material result remains continuous. Internal endcaps must not become visible protrusions in joined use.
approvedMiddleContinuity.familyChangeRule: Newer dock filter width0.5 does not change canonical rock source width1.5. Do not change this family sampling/light/material boundary implicitly. Propose any necessary change with native/consumer measurements before freeze.

assemblyLaw.mandatoryProposed: Confirmed by root actual interaction inspection: end.W↔middle.E, same intrinsic facing; whole pair rotated throughN/E/S/W. Authored S placement is end@(2,2), middle@(1,2).
assemblyLaw.sameFacingPortWitness: End W and exact middle E meet at the same world point with opposing outward normals. Root separation exactly1 native unit,128 logical pixels.

reversedMiddleDiagnostic.geometry: middle.W rotated180 relative to end.W is same-profile by metadata and exactly matches outer profile.
reversedMiddleDiagnostic.freezeScope: Diagnostic retained. Root confirms intended authored same-handed connection is mandatory. Exact simultaneous boundary albedo identity to both immutable orientations is not required.

consumerContract.ordering: Actual orderPlacements: background/world/foreground pass, world depth/rootCell, layer, input order; explicit supportedBy adds dependency order without changing ordinary depth. No support dependency is used by these wall pairs.
consumerContract.sampling: Actual worldRasterPlan anchors common native grid; paintWorldRaster resizes first, then sets imageSmoothingEnabled=false. Complete shared canvas is displayed at100% in SVG foreignObject; ordinary browser whole-canvas filtering remains auto.
consumerContract.immutableInputs: Exact original end catalog descriptor/images and approved-middle fixed frame/root/footprint/scale descriptor plus exact canonical images. No current global library, target image or other object dependency.
consumerContract.coverage: 288 renderer cases;32 retained screenshots. All4 end facings, same-facing and reversed middle, pitches128/32/47.3, phases(0,0),(.25,.5),(.5,.75),(.75,.25), gray/light/dark backgrounds. Browser viewports900×700,390×844,844×390 respectively. This is a bounded renderer check, not a claim that current product page/Godot integration passes.

topologyNormalAndResourceOwnership.source: End source meshes use native material graphs, no UV layers/image textures, and no rig/actions. The complete b176 library also contains two packed food images unused by own meshes; no linked libraries.
topologyNormalAndResourceOwnership.canonical: Continuous carved side with native geometric relief, interior-relief caps, smooth custom boundary normals, vertex albedo; no used external image/library resources.
topologyNormalAndResourceOwnership.finalRequirement: Own editable3D source with meaningful stone geometry and explicit normal/material/resource audit. No target billboard or raster repair. Declare and pack/hash any actual added resources. Part counts, redundant shoulder/plates and old normal discontinuities may be repaired freely.
